subtitle: Lesson 20 · Backup & Recovery with T-SQL

eyebrow: Step one of a restore sequence
caption: NORECOVERY leaves the database RESTORING, waiting for more backups.

code:
RESTORE FILELISTONLY
FROM DISK = 'D:\Backups\AdventureWorks2012_Full.bak';

RESTORE DATABASE AdventureWorks2012
FROM DISK = 'D:\Backups\AdventureWorks2012_Full.bak'
WITH MOVE 'AdventureWorks2012_Data' TO 'E:\Data\AdventureWorks2012.mdf',
     MOVE 'AdventureWorks2012_Log' TO 'F:\Logs\AdventureWorks2012_log.ldf',
     RECOVERY;
caption: FILELISTONLY reveals the logical names MOVE needs.
